summary: The registrant, reAlpha Tech Corp., filed an 8-K to report receipt of a Nasdaq notice confirming compliance with the minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)), closing a prior deficiency. No specific terms or financial details are disclosed; the closing bid price remained at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from April 30 to May 13, 2026. The board did not issue a recommendation or name advisors. This is a routine compliance update with no structural or financial mechanics involved. The filing does not constitute a special situation; it is an operational reinstatement of listing standards.
